author: Peng 沈鹏
text:
Quick confession 🙋‍♂️ I haven't taken a single meeting note in 3 months.
Not because I stopped caring.
I just noticed something — while I was busy writing down what you said 30 seconds ago, I was missing what you're saying right now .
For me, note-taking was never really listening.
It was a safety net. Pen-shaped. 🖊️
So I handed the notes to AI —
and took the conversation back.
Know someone who's always typing in meetings? Send this fun video their way 👇
